mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in CPIAUCSL and decrease in FEDFUNDS indicates policy response to inflation, which precedes positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days due to the interaction effect exceeding individual series impacts.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not significant: Rank IC for combined signal remains below 0.03, or positive returns occur in less than 55% of cases when CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS falls.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market regime (UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly), rising employment growth signals strong economic momentum that drives positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
regime_hint: tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly)
failure_condition: In the tight labor market regime, S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) reflects strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST increases, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 2000 thousand units, it signals robust residential construction activity that drives positive S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 2000.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates broad-based economic momentum, which typically precedes positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days due to reinforcing demand-supply effects.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not significant: Rank IC for combined signal remains below 0.03, or positive returns occur in less than 55% of cases when both HOUST and INDPRO rise.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime (INDPRO growth < 0.5% monthly), a decline in industrial production signals manufacturing weakness that leads to negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as the market anticipates economic slowdown.
failure_condition: In the supply contraction regime, S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC falls below 0.02.
